Description de l'entreprise
Cream is an Information Technology consulting firm with a proven experience in combining Innovation Delivery, Motivating Culture and Continuous Improvement - what we call Enterprise Agility.
We deliver our services to industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, Pharmaceutical & Transport.
Cream is developing rapidly his network of consultants especially thanks to his growing portfolio of clients. For that reason, we are looking to recruit new consultants to strengthen our teams.
Our objective is to assemble the best talents so as to build multidisciplinary teams supported by the expertise of our Practices.
Services:
> Information System
> Infrastructure
> Big data/ Businnes Intelligence
> Project Management
> Agile
> Digitalization
> Product
> Compliance
Description de la fonction
What is a Business Analyst in insurance domain at cream?
As Stella, Business Analyst (in Insurance Domain), embrace your role and support the different applications in the insurance industry (life and non life). You will be the liaison among business and IT teams.
Your tasks
Participate and lead requirements gathering sessions with clients
Produce Functional Design and Requirements Specification documents on domains of expertise e.g. New Business, Claims, etc.
Implement, in means of configuration, relevant aspects of the client's requirements
Write/ Review test plans
Perform expert testing and defect management following development/configuration
Conduct training sessions on the system and its configured product set
Production support including UAT testing, defect analysis and Change Requests management
Perform gap analysis
How do we imagine our future Consultant
You have a Master degree or equivalent experience
Minimum 5 years of experience: ideally 3 or more years of experience within an insurance company
You have proven experience as a Business Analyst
You can meet project deadlines and provide high-quality deliverables
You have a cultural openness and adaptability, you are rigorous, customer-oriented and you have high communications skills and analytical skills
You are able to work with autonomy while being also a great team player
You are fluent in French and a good command of English, Dutch is a plus
You are committed to travelling abroad occasionally upon the client's request
